Dear Larkspur team,

I'm hoping to hire the Castellan Imperial for my sister's wedding day - it's still a few months to go but I'm getting everything sorted out. We would pick it up on 5 June 2027 at 12 pm and bring it back on Mon 7 Jun 2027 at 12.00pm, collecting it from your garage. I've always loved the way your cars look, especially with wedding ribbons, so I think it would be perfect for the occasion. Your website says the total comes to €1,218.00. I have attached my driving licence.

Best wishes,
Lena Corbyngton
+70 701 576 5332
